title: Write 8 · 子 明 少 昨 儿 白 房 工 作 事 前 爱 地 跟 喜
focus: 子 明 少 昨 儿 白 房 工 作 事 前 爱 地 跟 喜
body:
Repeating parts: 日 (明, 昨, 白), 乍 (昨, 作), 亻 (作), 土 (地), 口 (喜), ⻊ foot (跟), 方 (房).

## Rules that matter here
- **Through-strokes last**: 事 ends with its long vertical hook.
- **Top to bottom stacks**: 喜, 爱, 前.
- 作 vs 做 (both zuò), 昨 vs 作 vs 怎: same 乍 phonetic.

cards.Notes: 3 strokes: ㇇, vertical hook 亅, then the horizontal LAST. Lookalike: 了 (no horizontal), 孑.
日 sun (4) + 月 moon (4) = 8 strokes. Left before right. Sun + moon = bright.
小 small (3) + ノ (1) = 4 strokes. Centre vertical first, then dots, then the long ノ. Lookalike: 小, 沙.
日 sun (4) + 乍 (5, phonetic zhà) = 9 strokes. Left before right. Lookalikes: 作 (亻), 怎 (心 below).
2 strokes: ノ then 竖弯钩 (乚). Left before right. Lookalike: 几 jǐ (joined on top).
ノ (1) + 日 (4) = 5 strokes. Short ノ on top first, then 日. Lookalikes: 百 (一 on top), 自 (extra line).
户 door (4) + 方 (4, phonetic fāng) = 8 strokes. 户 first; 方 sits under its long ノ.
3 strokes: 一, 丨, then the longer bottom 一. Lookalikes: 土, 士, 干.
亻 person (2) + 乍 (5, phonetic zhà) = 7 strokes. Left before right. Lookalike: 做 (same sound, 11 strokes).
8 strokes: 一, 口, then the ⺕-like part, and the long vertical hook through everything LAST.
丷 (2) + 一 + 月 (4) + 刂 (2) = 9 strokes. Top first, then 月 left, 刂 right.
爫 claw (4) + 冖 cover (2) + 友 friend (4) = 10 strokes. Top to bottom. Simplified form lacks the 心.
土 earth (3) + 也 (3) = 6 strokes. On the left, 土's last horizontal becomes a rising stroke. Lookalikes: 他, 她.

cards.Prompt: ＿我来 · gēn wǒ lái · follow me
cards.Notes: ⻊ foot (7) + 艮 (6, phonetic gèn) = 13 strokes. Left before right. Lookalikes: 很, 根, 银.
士 (3) + 口 (3) + 丷一 (3) + 口 (3) = 12 strokes. Strictly top to bottom. Pictured as a drum over a mouth.
